sources.observed_facts: Historical plugin binds auditMiddlewareSvc.Audit through GlobalMiddlewares rather than subscribing to host audit events.
Plugin middleware constructs and persists its own operation-log record after request execution.
Login plugin actually subscribes to host successful/failed login/logout events, showing differing delivery by scope.
